decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service built on existing production that is still shown on the website, so results appear to meet aspiration and a large firm's slack makes it easy to carry.

The 72-hour express program is still mentioned and adds speed as a competitive edge against rivals, but its operational burden in a weak construction market makes it somewhat more vulnerable than the fifteen-day program.
The door and gate express program has kept its own page for two years, which signals sustained commitment and results at or above aspiration.
The online ordering platform is strategic digital infrastructure with its own page, matches industry-wide digitalization, and its uncertain returns are buffered by slack.
The fire and smoke protection door was moved up to its own page in 2024 and may be absorbing the market space of the dropped fire-resistant door C, which signals performance above aspiration.
